meta.title: DeepSeek Harness app controls
meta.description: Adds check/update and quit buttons to the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (conversation header and the top-right of the main interface), plus a KDE system-tray controller at tray/dsh-tray.py. The buttons check/update DSH with a progress dialog, or gracefully stop the service and close the window. The tray icon shows service status and exposes open, check/update, restart, stop, logs, copy URL and autostart. Applicable to DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.x Web profile on Linux (KDE Plasma, Chrome app window) and Node.js 20+; the tray helper needs PyQt5.
